title: Native tools contributed by capability functions are dropped under `override(native_tools=...)`
author: DouweM

comments.author: pydanty[bot]
comments.body:
<!-- pydanty:status-comment:v1 -->

## pydanty status: bug -- confirmed (high), signal 8/10 - p1

**Why:** Native tools contributed by capability functions (DynamicCapability) are silently dropped from model requests when override(native_tools=...) is active. This affects any user combining dynamic capabilities with native tool overrides -- a core runtime path (agent run loop + tool calling + capabilities). The fix requires restructuring capability resolution to call for_run exactly once, which is a design-sensitive internal refactor touching the agent run setup flow.
**Evidence:** Reproducer confirmed the bug: no-override path correctly includes dynamic MCPServerTool from capability function; override + static capability includes both override and static tools; override + capability function drops the dynamic tool -- only [CodeExecutionTool] appears in model request parameters. Mechanism: agent/__init__.py:1297-1298 reads cap.get_native_tools() on pre-for_run extra_capabilities, but DynamicCapability (capabilities/_dynamic.py) has no get_native_tools override and inherits AbstractCapability's default returning []. The non-override path correctly uses run_capability (post-for_run resolved). Repositorian confirmed from PR #6242 review that DouweM rejected the double for_run workaround and requires resolving capabilities exactly once. code_librarian was unavailable (both calls failed with read_repository_file retry exhaustion), so the exact integration point for the single-resolution restructure could not be confirmed from code.
**Playground:** null
**Next:** needs_maintainer_discussion -- Fix direction is clear from DouweM's PR #6242 review, but the implementation requires restructuring the capability resolution flow in agent/__init__.py to resolve run capabilities exactly once and feed resolved instances into the override path -- a non-trivial internal refactor where code_librarian was unavailable to confirm the exact integration point and CombinedCapability helper API, so the PR opener needs more specific code surface information before implementing.

@adtyavrdhn -- assigned for prioritization (p1, signal 8/10).
